mLocKeys.keySummary: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Garen rapidly spins his sword for @Duration@ seconds, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage @f1@ times over the duration. The nearest enemy takes @NearestEnemyBonus*100@% increased damage. Champions hit by @StacksToShred@ strikes lose @ShredAmount*100@% Armor for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

Recast: Garen ends this Ability early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Gains one strike from every @ASPerTick*100@% Attack Speed from items and levels.
Can critically strike for @CriticalDamage@ physical damage.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Garen's spinning sword shreds Armor, reducing this unit's Armor by a percentage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Garen regenerates <healing>@RegenCalc@ max Health</healing> every 5 seconds if he has not been damaged or hit with enemy Abilities in the last @DamageTimer@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Garen regenerates @RegenCalc@ max Health every 5 seconds if he has not been damaged or hit with enemy Abilities in the last @DamageTimer@ seconds.

Minion and non-epic jungle monster damage does not stop the regeneration.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Garen has taken damage recently and Perseverance is on cooldown.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Garen removes all Slowing effects on him and gains @MovementSpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @MovementSpeedDuration@ second(s).

His next Attack Silences for @SilenceDuration@ seconds and does @TotalDamage@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The empowered Attack expires after @AttackWindow@ seconds.
This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Garen's next attack silences his target and deals bonus damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to slay his enemy, dealing <trueDamage>@BaseDamage@ plus @ExecuteDamage*100@% missing Health true damage</trueDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Garen has @ResistsForTooltip@ bonus Armor and @ResistsForTooltip@ bonus Magic Resist. Killing units permanently grants @ResistGainOnKillTooltip@ resists, up to a max of @ResistMax@.

Active: Garen steels his courage for @DRDuration@ seconds, reducing incoming damage by @DRPercent*100@%. He also gains @TotalShield@ Shield and @UpfrontTenacity*100@% Tenacity for @UpfrontDuration@ seconds.
